tone: Professional, friendly, and concise. Reply in the customer's language. Avoid jargon; use simple sentences. For device/account/order issues, guide to support-center@comulytic.ai; for Amazon channel do not include URLs or external email.

faqs.content: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Customer must initiate return from order page where applicable. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the item. For assistance contact support-center@comulytic.ai.
Standard shipping: 5-7 business days. Express: 2-3 business days. We ship from US warehouses for US orders.
If you received wrong item or defective product, please reply with your order ID and photos. We will send replacement or full refund at no extra cost. Contact support-center@comulytic.ai.

Check if received by family/neighbor. Obtain proof of delivery from carrier (e.g. photos, GPS). If carrier cannot provide proof, request lost-package case ID. Contact support-center@comulytic.ai for follow-up.
Credit card (Visa, Mastercard), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay (varies by region). Check checkout page for local options.

Check card number, expiry, CVV, billing address. Contact issuing bank (may block international/online). Try another card or PayPal. If unresolved, send screenshot of error to support-center@comulytic.ai.

Paid orders cannot be edited directly. Contact support-center@comulytic.ai as soon as possible to cancel and reorder with correct details. Address changes before shipment may be attempted but not guaranteed.
Electronic invoice or receipt after payment: check order confirmation email attachment or Order History on website. Issues: contact support-center@comulytic.ai with order number.

Comulytic Note Pro offers unlimited transcription and basic summary time. No duration limits for normal use. Subscription and membership details in app; enable push for updates. Questions: support-center@comulytic.ai.
If subscribed via App Store or Google Play, cancel through those platforms (see Apple/Google cancellation guides). Difficulties: contact support-center@comulytic.ai from linked email.

Press and hold recording button 2 seconds to power on. Check if screen lights up; if not, device may be out of battery—charge with included cable at least 10 minutes. Still not found: support-center@comulytic.ai.

Enable Bluetooth on both device and phone. Make device discoverable: hold recording button 2 seconds, then try pairing. Keep device close to phone, no obstacles. Still not connecting: support-center@comulytic.ai.
Go to Device Management, select the device, click Unbind Device and confirm. If unbinding fails, contact support-center@comulytic.ai and provide the device serial number (SN).
Power on: press and hold button 2 seconds. If device unresponsive: press and hold 12 seconds to force reset, then power on. Check for debris around button; clean gently.
Press and hold device button about 12 seconds to restart. If stuck on transmission screen, try turning phone Bluetooth off and on, or restart Comulytic app.
Ensure stable Wi-Fi or mobile data; check app has network/permission for upload; confirm file format (e.g. MP3, WAV) and size within limit. Try exit and reopen app.
Charge at least 30 minutes with original cable. Press and hold button 2 seconds to power on. If problem continues: support-center@comulytic.ai.
Exit app and try upgrade again. Turn Bluetooth off and on then retry. If persists: support-center@comulytic.ai.

Clean charging contacts and cable; use adapter 5V/0.5A; use original cable. If battery long unused, charge 1-2 hours to activate. Still not working after overnight charge: support-center@comulytic.ai.

Device has temperature protection (overheat or cold). It saves the current recording before shutting down; no data loss. Wait until device returns to room temperature to power on again. Three lines = high temp; snowflake = low temp.

Ensure stable internet. Check email format and password (upper, lower, numbers, special chars, 8+ length). If email already registered try login or different email. Still failing: support-center@comulytic.ai.
Comulytic app supports Sign in with Apple. Select it on sign-in page. Verify Apple ID on Apple site if needed. Issues: support-center@comulytic.ai.

Update app to latest; upgrade phone OS if low; restart phone (free memory); if frequent crashes uninstall and reinstall. Unresponsive: check network; wait if syncing/transcribing; close and reopen app. If persists provide crash time and steps to support.

Ensure stable network; click Retry if prompted. Processing ~7 min per hour of audio; can leave page. For accuracy: clear recording, minimal noise, correct language in settings; try re-transcribe. Support: support-center@comulytic.ai.

On file detail page click Name Speaker to correct names; set correct speakers before generating summary for better accuracy. Multiple speakers or noise can reduce accuracy. Support: support-center@comulytic.ai.
Check network; during peak wait and retry. Use Retry on failure page. If persists: support-center@comulytic.ai.
Ensure clear human voice in recording; use Regenerate and choose template; manually edit if needed. For longer summary: assistant icon → Summary more detailed. Feedback: support-center@comulytic.ai.
On file detail page click speaker to name them; save to create contact (visible in contact list). On contact page tag related audio clips for insights and profile.
Assistant appears after summary is generated. Click assistant icon for retrieval, analysis, optimized summary, follow-up email. Wait for summary first.
Full-featured web app: https://web.comulytic.ai (editing, multitask). To sync between app and web: in App go to Me → Cloud Backup and turn on; same account on both.

Remove device: thumb and index on both sides (thumb on circle mark), pull outward to create gap, then pull device out. Case not sticking: align magnet/MagSafe; avoid thick phone case; clean dirt/oil. support-center@comulytic.ai if persists.
Check all compartments of packaging. Note what is missing and contact support-center@comulytic.ai with purchase info and description; we will resolve as soon as possible.

Lost ring: can use phone case with magnetic ring plus Comulytic leather case. Damaged under warranty: contact support-center@comulytic.ai for replacement. Wireless charging not supported; 1.5h wired fast charge.
Avoid humid or wet environments. Use waterproof bag if near water. Store in leather case or packaging when not in use. support-center@comulytic.ai for other needs.
Email support-center@comulytic.ai and include 'urgent' in the subject line; customer service manager will follow up promptly.

Recording stored on device then transferred to app (deleted from device). With cloud backup off: only text/summaries to cloud after processing. With cloud backup on: audio and text in your AWS space. All data stored and transmitted with AES-256 encryption.

Keep account password safe. App Lock and Contact Profile Lock available (password/face/fingerprint). Delete: remove file in app then permanently in Trash (removes related insights); delete contact or account removes associated data.

Often due to battery fully drained (clock stopped) or daylight saving. Once device connects to app, time auto-calibrates; new recordings will be accurate. Open app before important recordings; charge regularly and connect after DST change.
